name: a-soft-reset-naming-keel-is-allowed
description: `--soft` moves HEAD only and touches neither the index nor the working tree, so a reset carrying it is excluded before the .keel/ name test ever runs, even though this one names a .keel/ path in its own text - the same direction rule 3 already takes for a provably content-free `sed` print.
